[R235] POSITIVE - exact head a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3

# R235-1 independent review: issue #464 / PR #513

- Reviewer: R235, cleared-context internal Opus session. Round: R235-1.
- Review start (public): PR #513 comment 5777127589.
- Head under review: `a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3`, tree `31ddc6b5615ff91ceed7a6b52afca61c5fb9653d`.
  Parents: dev `88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896` (first) and author head `1576f0893ae9781074fffb105f5384fe774ff11e`.
- Validation base: live `dev` `88e9276b`, re-read at 2026-09-22T13:31:38Z. The PR head was still `a769d9db`, ready (not draft) and open.
- Read, in order: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md, the issue #464 body and all 14 public comments, and the PR #513 body and 3 comments. Then REQUIREMENTS.md REQ-VER-03/04, IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.2.19 and Table 7-32, Milan v1.2 5.3.3.7 to 5.3.3.9, and docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md (item 11 and the docs-check shape-gate section). Then the PR diff, its three commits, and the hosted logs for the exact head.
- Not read: author private reasoning, any other reviewer's report, or lane-local material. Of the manager's public evidence packet, only identity and exit-status files were read (listed under Limits).

## Verdict

POSITIVE. I applied all five lenses at the exact head. No BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR finding is open. Three SUGGESTIONs are recorded; by definition they are optional and do not affect coverage.

## Clean-lens results

[R235] PASS Conformance - avdecc/gen_aem_store.py:157-322, .github/workflows/docs.yml:384-391, scripts/ci_events.py:1065-1068 at a769d9db - Acceptance criteria 1 to 3 hold, and so do the readiness decision (issue comment 5770832953) and scope confirmation (5775302273).
- The causes are reproduced (E1, E2).
- `--self-test` exits 0 at the head on 3.14.7, 3.12.13 and 3.11.15. Hosted docs-check step 42 prints 20 ok and PASS (E8).
- The new step is pinned and recognised (E7).
- No arm was removed; the same six deviations are held exact both ways (E3); no validator or allowlist was widened; no generated byte changed (E9).
- The quoted Milan v1.2 5.3.3.9 and IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.2.19 / Table 7-32 text matches the standards (E12).

[R235] PASS RTL - receipts/delta-name-status.txt, gitlinks at ec34fcde/88e9276b/1576f089/a769d9db, receipts/regen-builtin-outputs.txt, avdecc/aem_emit.py:271-293 and :407-431 - The PR changes no RTL and no processor pin, and leaves the protocol-processor-facing contracts intact.
- No HDL/SV/V/SVH path and no gitlink is in the delta; file modes are preserved.
- protocol-processor stays at 424c688f, gptp-processor at c1b61743 and verilog-axis at 48ff7a7e.
- The builtin `aecp_aem_rom.svh` (AEM_SMAP_* tables included) and `aem_rom.json` are byte-identical at base and head.
- The emitters read only the SMAP serving tables, never DEVIATIONS or KNOWN_MAP_DEVIATIONS.

[R235] PASS Robustness - avdecc/gen_aem_store.py:202-231, receipts/mutation-matrix/SUMMARY.txt, receipts/workflow-mutations/SUMMARY.txt - The self-test fails closed under every failure mode I planted.
- A fixture shared across vectors is caught (S01), and so is an invalid fixture (M20, X7).
- A wrong-cause ValueError is caught (M05). Removed index bounds fail closed through an uncaught IndexError, rc=1 (M04, M09).
- The CI step cannot be skipped, swallowed, redirected, re-shelled, given injected env, reordered, renamed or duplicated without `ci_events --check` refusing (W01 to W17).
- The self-test writes no product file (content hashes unchanged). It runs with no submodule contents and without PyYAML (3.12 and 3.11 git-archive extracts).

[R235] PASS Tests - receipts/mutation-matrix/SUMMARY.txt, receipts/raise-site-binding.txt, receipts/selftest-matrix/, receipts/ci_events/head-selftest.log - Loss of each claimed bound is detected, and every arm is preserved.
- 42 of 42 expectation-bearing plants met on both 3.14 and 3.12: 33 caught, 5 neutral controls, 4 load-bearing demonstrations.
- Each of the nine AUDIO_MAP vectors raises at exactly its named guard line. Each oracle fragment occurs in exactly 1 of the 34 ValueError raise sites in avdecc/.
- All 19 base arm names survive verbatim, plus 1 new fixture arm.
- `ci_events --selftest` has 1150 arms, including the 6 new step-41 arms. My 18 independent workflow plants all met their expectations.
- S2 and S3 are open as SUGGESTION only.

[R235] PASS Docs - docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md:1059-1067, docs/testing/RUNNING_TESTS.md:24, .github/workflows/docs.yml:384-389, avdecc/gen_aem_store.py:9-11 and :67-68, avdecc/aem_maps.py:103-106 - Every changed sentence was checked against the code and the runs (E11), and the PR and issue carry reproducible evidence.
- Step placement, command, own-bound refusal, fixture, positive control, "no step ran it before", "first-party files only / no submodule / no dependency", and the descriptor counts all hold.
- The sweep found no stale current documentation.
- Em-dash: 0 in all added lines. The hosted gate judged `[88e9276b..HEAD]`: 11 lines, 0 findings.
- `git diff --check` is clean. All three commits are one line with no trailers.
- S1 is open as SUGGESTION only.

## Findings

[R235] SUGGESTION Docs - avdecc/gen_aem_store.py:173 (overrides at :178-188) - fixture docstring says every non-bounding field is the deployed model's, but the names are not
Requirement/evidence: The docstring says "Every field that bounds no mapping is the deployed model's." The fixture does more than that:
- It re-declares the stream names as `AAF in`, `CRF in` and `AAF out`. The deployed model's names are `Stream 1`, `CRF` and `Stream Output 0` (avdecc/aem_specs.py:52-56).
- It sets `cluster_names_in/out=None`, so its clusters take the generic `Input`/`Output` names (avdecc/aem_assemble.py:284-285). The deployed names are `I2S Out n`/`Virtual Out n`/`I2S In n`/`Virtual In n` (avdecc/aem_specs.py:80-83).

Names bound no mapping, and no cause fragment contains a name (receipts/raise-site-binding.txt).
Impact: None on the gate or on any arm's verdict. A reader could take the sentence to mean the fixture differs from the deployed model only in fields that bound mappings.
Required change: Optional. Either state that the fixture also re-declares the stream names and defaults the cluster names, or keep the deployed names.
Verification: Read the docstring against the keys in `_map_fixture()`'s `spec.update(...)`. The self-test stays 20/20.

[R235] SUGGESTION Tests - avdecc/gen_aem_store.py:268-286 with avdecc/aem_maps.py:171, :293, :306 - boundary and rule-scope coverage (pre-existing; not claimed by this PR)
Requirement/evidence: See receipts/boundary-mutations/SUMMARY.txt.
- Detected: tightening of the cluster_offset, stream_index and base_map bounds (B2, B3, B4), because the fixture uses each range in full.
- B1, not detected: refusing a 62-mapping map. No arm accepts exactly 62, although IEEE 1722.1-2021 Table 7-32 allows 62.
- L1, not detected: narrowing the 7.2.19 OUTPUT rule from "across the entire Configuration" to a single port. The fixture has one output port, although the arm's label quotes that scope.
- L2, not detected: widening the INPUT rule from one map to every input port. The fixture has one input port.

The base self-test had the same single-port geometry and no 62-accept arm (b7d0bbcd, 88e9276b). The PR claims detection of a bound's loss, and that holds (M06, M07, M10, M11).
Impact: A change that refuses a conformant 62-mapping map, or mis-scopes either duplicate rule across ports, would pass this self-test. Whether the builder gates would catch it was not measured.
Required change: Optional. This is new coverage, so it belongs in a follow-up Issue rather than this lane:
- an accept arm at exactly 62 mappings on the output map, for example `[[0, c, c % 8, 0] for c in range(62)]`;
- two-port fixture variants with cross-port vectors for both directions.

Verification: B1, L1 and L2 in scripts/boundary_mutations.py report DETECTED.

[R235] SUGGESTION Tests - avdecc/gen_aem_store.py:335-381 with avdecc/aem_assemble.py:56-65 and :112-118 - the directory arms carry no cause oracle (pre-existing; byte-unchanged by this PR)
Requirement/evidence: In receipts/mutation-matrix (P01, P02), removing only the contiguity assertion, or only the zero-based ascending assertion, leaves the self-test green. `check_two_level` refuses the same layouts for a different reason, and `dir_refuses` accepts any ValueError. The larger failures are caught: the whole layout-assertion set removed (P05), the equivalence check neutered (P03), or the name check neutered (P04). The PR's own-bound claim is scoped to AUDIO_MAP vectors (docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md:1062).
Impact: None today, because the equivalence check still refuses these layouts. A loss of one layer stays invisible until the second layer is lost too.
Required change: Optional, as a follow-up Issue: give each directory arm a cause fragment, the way #464 did for the AUDIO_MAP vectors.
Verification: P01 and P02 in scripts/mutation_matrix.py become DETECTED.

## Evidence

All runs used isolated `git archive` extracts, or minimal copies made from them. Nothing ran in the review checkout. Receipt paths are relative to this report's directory.

E1. First failure and causal roots. Source: receipts/selftest-matrix/selftest-matrix.txt and its logs.

| Commit | 3.14.7 | 3.12.13 and 3.11.15 |
|---|---|---|
| head `a769d9db` | rc=0, 20 ok | rc=0, 20 ok |
| source `1576f089` | rc=0, 20 ok | rc=0, 20 ok |
| base `88e9276b` (and `ec34fcde`) | rc=1 after 1 ok: IndexError at gen_aem_store.py:194, `s["audio_maps"][1] = ...` | rc=1: NameError `Callable`, at :161 `def refuses(...)` |
| `b7d0bbcd`, parent of `da71309c` | rc=0, 19 ok | rc=0, 19 ok |
| `da71309c` | rc=1, IndexError in `global_index` | rc=1, IndexError in `global_index` |

- `da71309c` made the input port dynamic, moved `base_map` from 1 to 0, and cut two maps to one (verified in its diff).
- `25f543b9` (2026-09-04) postdates `b7d0bbcd` and added the unimported `Callable` annotation.
- The head's 3.14 and 3.12 transcripts are byte-identical.

E2. Base vectors replayed on the base deployed model (receipts/probe-base-vectors.txt):
- Three raise IndexError while the vector is applied: global_index, OUTPUT dup and OUTPUT accept.
- Two are refused for another cause: INPUT dup (by the OUTPUT rule) and CRF (by stream_index).
- base_map, maps, cluster_channel, stream_index and 63-mappings are refused for their own cause. cluster_channel and stream_index hit the output port.
- The base allowlist matched none of the model's 6 deviations (6 new, 6 stale).

E3. Deviations (receipts/deviation-identity.txt):
- Head set = base set with `AUDIO_MAP[1]` changed to `AUDIO_MAP[0]`. Each string differs from its base twin in exactly one character.
- Head deployed deviations: 6 listed, 6 distinct. model minus recorded is empty; recorded minus model is empty.
- The fixture's own 6 deviations are the old `AUDIO_MAP[1]` strings and do not intersect the recorded set.
- Readers of `KNOWN_MAP_DEVIATIONS`/`assert_no_map_deviations`: only avdecc/aem_maps.py (definition and default argument) and the self-test in avdecc/gen_aem_store.py. None exist in sw/, scripts/, tb/, tests/ or the processor trees.

E4. Mutation matrix (scripts/mutation_matrix.py; receipts/mutation-matrix/SUMMARY.txt). 44 plants of exact single-count edits, run on 3.14 and 3.12 with identical exit codes. Every plant's edit applied exactly once (no INVALID).
- Caught (33):
  - Each AUDIO_MAP bound removed: M01, M03, M04, M05, M06, M07, M08, M09, M10.
  - Bounds loosened: cluster_offset `>` (M02) and Table 7-32 max 63 (M11).
  - The INPUT rule applied to both directions (M12) and the OUTPUT rule applied to both (M13).
  - Allowlist stale (M14), widened (M15, caught by the reverse check only), narrowed (M16) and neutered (M17). Deviation no longer recorded (M18). Gate bypassed (M19). Static inputs refused (M20).
  - A deployed deviation added (D01, forward check only) or removed (D02, reverse check only).
  - Fixture shared (S01) or replaced by the deployed geometry (S02).
  - Oracle kept with the base 62-vector (X4). New geometry without the oracle (X5). Acceptance arm removed plus static inputs refused (X7).
  - Directory-gate pieces: P03, P04 and P05. Base-format pieces: P06, P07 and P08.
- Neutral controls pass (5): P00, S03, S04, S05, S06.
- Load-bearing demonstrations, which pass as designed (4):
  - X1: no oracle, CRF refusal removed.
  - X2: no reverse check, widened allowlist.
  - X3: no oracle, base 62-vector, count bound removed.
  - X6: no oracle, OUTPUT rule applied to both.
- Observe only (2): P01 and P02 not detected (S3).

E5. Boundary and scope, observe only (scripts/boundary_mutations.py): B2, B3 and B4 detected; B1, L1 and L2 not detected (S2).

E6. Raise-site binding (receipts/raise-site-binding.txt): each head vector raises at its own guard. Lines in aem_maps.py:
- 189 (cluster_offset), 165 (base_map), 158 (number_of_maps)
- 198 (cluster_channel), 204 (stream_index), 258 (INPUT rule)
- 226 (CRF), 272 (OUTPUT rule), 171 (Table 7-32)

Each fragment is carried by exactly 1 of the 34 ValueError raise sites in avdecc/*.py.

E7. CI contract.
- Local `ci_events` counts, head against base: `--check` 1513 against 1505 items; `--selftest` PASS with 1150 against 1144 arms (receipts/ci_events/).
- The new arms are exactly six, all on docs-check step 41: no-op, or-true, append-command, drop-flag, continue-on-error, and missing record. The vacuity arms go from 1046 to 1051.
- The record at scripts/ci_events.py:1065-1068 pins the step's name, its position (after "Per-page contents gate", before "Sweep/build shape gate") and the exact normalized script `python3 avdecc/gen_aem_store.py --self-test`. That binds the source path and the proof flag. As item 11 specifies for every carrier, it pins the command, not the script's bytes.
- The five `44 steps` count arms (scripts/ci_events.py:6875, 6889, 6902, 6905, 6951) are the only step-count literals. No stale `43` remains in the tree.
- The 18 independent plants all met expectation (receipts/workflow-mutations/SUMMARY.txt). W13 shows that removing the step and its record together still fails `--selftest` through the count arms.
- `scripts/act_ci.py` vets only `uses:` steps, so the new `run:` step leaves it unaffected.
- docs.yml runs on every `pull_request` and on pushes to `dev`/`main` with no path filter, and the step has no `if`.

E8. Hosted execution at the exact head: docs run 35729759797 (pull_request, head_sha a769d9db, attempt 1), job 106752129822 `docs-check` on the ubuntu-24.04 image.
- Step 42 "AEM store generator self-test" ran 12:59:18.44 to 12:59:18.52Z: 20 `[ok]`, 0 `[FAIL]`, "gen_aem_store self-test: PASS" (receipts/hosted-docs-check-job.log:3734-3777).
- Step 37: `ci_events: OK (1513 ...)` at log line 2266, and `selftest: PASS (1513 contract items, 1150 arms)` at line 3418.
- At 13:31:38Z all seven required contexts had concluded `success` on a769d9db: rtl-fast, docs-check, wire-accountability, docs-check-no-git, elaborate, verilator-suites and yosys-portability (receipts/hosted-check-runs-final.json).

E9. Shipping-byte scope.
- The only non-test production edit is the `KNOWN_MAP_DEVIATIONS` index text and its comment. The census in E3 shows no generation path reads it.
- The gen_aem_store.py edits are its docstring, one import, the fixture and the self-test functions. None of these is on the emit path.
- Regenerated builtin outputs are byte-identical at base and head: `--out-dir` `aecp_aem_rom.svh` and `aem_rom.json`, the default-target `aem_rom.json`, and the CLI transcripts (receipts/regen-builtin-outputs.txt).
- The author's 83-file comparison is attributed to 1576f089 against ec34fcde (issue comment 5775408351, PR body). It covers the five configs in `sw/builder/test_builder.py` `CONFIGS`. It transfers to the candidate only because #507's six paths (docs/DOC_GENERATION.md and scripts/gen_toc*.py/check_em_dash.py) are disjoint from every generation path. The PR body states that scope correctly.
- The tracked `avdecc/aem_rom.json` differs from its own regeneration at both base and head. It is identical between them, pre-existing, and routed to #495; it is not a finding here.

E10. Identity.
- `git diff --full-index 88e9276b a769d9db` is byte-identical to `git diff --full-index ec34fcde 1576f089` (sha256 bcf40aee...).
- #507 and #464 paths are disjoint.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree 88e9276b 1576f089` reproduces tree `31ddc6b5`.
- The public candidate records name a769d9db, tree 31ddc6b5 and base 88e9276b, with 41/41 builder/static and 5/5 native exit 0. Both clones carry integrity PASS with the same four gitlinks. These are manager evidence, inspected for identity only.

E11. Docs checks.
- Every CI_WORKFLOWS.md:1059-1067 sentence is verified by E1, E4, E7 and E8, and by the base-tree search showing that no workflow or script invoked the store self-test before this change.
- "First-party files only / no submodule / no dependency" is verified three ways: extracts without submodule contents, minimal trees holding only avdecc/ and hdl/common/csr/milan_csr.sv, and 3.12/3.11 without PyYAML.
- Docstring counts match the built model: CLOCK_SOURCE x2, AUDIO_MAP x1, AUDIO_CLUSTER x16, STREAM_INPUT x2 (receipts/builtin-descriptor-counts.txt).
- The stale-text sweep over current Markdown, Python, YAML, SV and feature files found no outdated self-test or deviation-index text. The hits outside the changed files are history pages and dated narrative.

E12. Standards and product boundary.
- Milan v1.2 5.3.3.9 says a Stream Port Input "shall not contain any AUDIO_MAP descriptor". The fixture's static input map is therefore a non-Milan, non-shipping shape. The author disclosed this, and it is in the PR's known limitations.
- sw/builder/endstation_builder.py:1419-1423 refuses a static Stream Port Input, so only a hand-written spec or overlay reaches the generator's INPUT-direction bounds that the fixture exercises.
- IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.2.19 gives the INPUT rule (unique cluster_offset/cluster_channel) and the OUTPUT rule (unique stream_index/stream_channel "across the entire Configuration", repeated cluster_offset allowed). Table 7-32 caps number_of_mappings at 62. This matches the self-test's statements and the new comment at gen_aem_store.py:278-282.

E13. Checkout integrity. receipts/integrity-before.txt equals receipts/integrity-after.txt in every field: head, tree, index `ls-files -s` hash, HEAD tree listing, gitlinks, submodule status, status, modes, and untracked/ignored counts. The raw `.git/index` sha256 (109de19d...) is unchanged. The three required submodules are clean at their pins (receipts/submodule-final.txt). Both scratch extracts still match their commits blob for blob (receipts/verify-extract-*.txt).

## Completion ledger (R235-1)

| Lens | Covering round | Exact head | Result | Open BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Conformance | R235-1 | a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3 | covered clean | none |
| RTL | R235-1 | a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3 | covered clean | none |
| Robustness | R235-1 | a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3 | covered clean | none |
| Tests | R235-1 | a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3 | covered clean (S2, S3 SUGGESTION) | none |
| Docs | R235-1 | a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3 | covered clean (S1 SUGGESTION) | none |

This ledger covers only this internal round. AGENTS section 7 also needs the external review (R236) and every other bullet. Any commit after a769d9db that touches a lens's scope un-covers that lens.

## Open findings

None at BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR. Open SUGGESTIONs, all optional: S1 (Docs), S2 (Tests) and S3 (Tests). S2 and S3 describe pre-existing coverage and are follow-up Issue material; they are not required in this lane.

## Limits

- I did not rerun the end-station builder. So I did not regenerate the five configs' aem_desc.bin/.json/.map at the candidate. The byte claim rests on E9's census, the builtin regeneration, #507 disjointness and the author's attributed comparison.
- I did not rerun the full native Verilator, Yosys, processor or behave suites, and did not run act or Docker. Hosted and manager results are reported as observed, with their identities.
- The hosted interpreter's version is not printed in the job log. I infer 3.12 from the ubuntu-24.04 image. My direct 3.12 evidence is local 3.12.13, plus 3.11.15.
- I ran `ci_events.py` locally only on 3.14. The local 3.12/3.11 interpreters lack PyYAML, and installs were out of bounds. The hosted run covers the hosted interpreter.
- Clause text came from local copies of IEEE 1722.1-2021 and Milan v1.2, extracted with `pdftotext`.
- The mutation plants ran in minimal trees. The P00 control and the extract runs show those trees are sufficient for the self-test. B1, L1, L2, P01 and P02 characterise coverage and are not graded against any PR claim.
- From the manager's public evidence commit `6ae76b6a` I read only: candidate.json, source-publication.json, full-native.json, full-native/{results,complete}.json, manager-builder/{results,complete}.json, native-tree-integrity.json and builder-final-tree-integrity.json. I did not read the author evidence or author receipts.
- Process deviation: one read-only interpreter-discovery command (`python3.x --version` and a PyYAML import probe) ran without the `rtk` prefix. It changed nothing.

## Outstanding manager duties

- Trusted act replica: PR comment 5776957449 records its start at 12:59Z. No completion was public during this review, and a start is not a pass.
- Hosted required contexts: observed all-success at a769d9db (E8). The manager records them.
